response.sql: WITH per_film AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate / rental_duration AS per_day FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL), per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day FROM per_film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS across_avg FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(pr.avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day_above, AVG(pr.avg_per_day - o.across_avg) AS avg_gap_above FROM per_rating pr CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE pr.avg_per_day > o.across_avg;
